title: The Thing I Did While Waiting for You to Fall Back in Love With Me ⭐️...
transcript: Theater is life and there's no better way to spend that life than at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Show number one that I saw was the things I did while waiting for you to fall back in Love With Me. A one woman show written and performed by Sarah Hoogewood and this was the perfect way to start off my friends trip. This is a one woman show that is self described as the lesbian hamlet and it's all about one woman's existential crisis after her fiance leaves her. Not all of the writing work for me, but ultimately I found this show extremely relatable and incredibly entertaining. And Sarah is an incredible performer. Like immediately as soon as she enters the space she just fills it with her energy and she keeps that going from beginning to end of the show. The comparison to hamlet is an incredibly loose one, so don't go in expecting that, but you can definitely see where the comparisons hit. I do wish the character work had been just a little bit stronger and not all of the transitions between scenes work for me, but ultimately I found this incredibly entertaining and worth a watch. This is definitely a one person show that I would like to see expanded at. I think the story is really interesting and Sarah is a great performer, but there were some times where I wish there were more actors on stage. Ultimately this is worth seeing, especially for Sarah's performance, and I cannot wait to see what she does after this because she definitely has that star quality.
